استجمعن (form X)
# اِسْتَجْمَعْنَ (istajmaʕna) /is.tad͡ʒ.maʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
# اُسْتُجْمِعْنَ (ustujmiʕna) /us.tud͡ʒ.miʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
# اِسْتَجْمِعْنَ (istajmiʕna) /is.tad͡ʒ.miʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
